title: Representation formula Σ_j ∫ K_j(t)·∂_j a(y − t) dt = a(y) (Step 4; Gilbarg–Trudinger, proof of Lemma 7.14)
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ and n := m + 1, and let ω := Lⁿ(B_1(0)) ∈ (0,∞), as a real number. For j ∈ Fin n let K_j(t) := t_j/((m + 1)·ω·|t|^{m+1}) on ℝⁿ = Eucl n; K_j(0) = 0 because division by 0 gives 0. Let a : ℝⁿ → ℝ be C^∞ with compact support, and let y ∈ ℝⁿ. Then Σ_{j ∈ Fin n} ∫ K_j(t)·∂_j a(y − t) dt = a(y). Here ∂_j a(z) := Da(z)e_j, and e_j = EuclideanSpace.single j 1 is the j-th standard basis vector.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (a : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) a → HasCompactSupport a → ∀ y : Eucl (m + 1), ∑ j : Fin (m + 1), ∫ t, t j / (((m : ℝ) + 1) * (volume (ball (0 : Eucl (m + 1)) 1)).toReal * ‖t‖ ^ (m + 1)) * fderiv ℝ a (y - t) (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) = a y
